fullPassage: Ecosystem structure refers to the individuals and communities of plants and animals of which an ecosystem is composed, their age and spatial distribution, and the abiotic resources. Most ecosystems have thousands of structural elements, each exhibiting varying degrees of complexity. Scientists have learned that when enough separate elements are thrown together into a complex system, a sort of spontaneous order results. One property of such systems is their tendency to generate emergent phenomena, which can be defined as properties of the whole that could not be predicted from an understanding of the individual parts, no matter how detailed that understanding. Complex systems are also characterized by highly nonlinear behavior, which means that we cannot predict the outcomes of large interventions based on an understanding of smaller ones. For example, removing 40% of a species stock from an ecosystem may have a qualitatively different impact than removing 20% — that is, not just twice the known impact of removing 20%.

③ abiotic resources(비생물적 자원): 생태계 구조 설명에서 등장하나 정의와 무관
④ spatial distribution(공간적 분포): 나이와 분포 맥락이지 현상 정의 아님

questions.passage: Ecosystem structure refers to the individuals and communities of plants and animals of which an ecosystem is composed, their age and spatial distribution, and the abiotic resources. Most ecosystems have thousands of structural elements, each exhibiting varying degrees of complexity. Scientists have learned that when enough separate elements are thrown together into __________, a sort of spontaneous order results. One property of such systems is their tendency to generate emergent phenomena, which can be defined as properties of the whole that could not be predicted from an understanding of the individual parts, no matter how detailed that understanding. Complex systems are also characterized by highly nonlinear behavior, which means that we cannot predict the outcomes of large interventions based on an understanding of smaller ones. For example, removing 40% of a species stock from an ecosystem may have a qualitatively different impact than removing 20% — that is, not just twice the known impact of removing 20%.

det.korean: 별개의 요소들이 복잡한 체계 속에 합쳐질 때
det.analysis:
충분한 별개의 요소들이 ____에 합쳐지면 일종의 자발적 질서가 나타난다.
① the individual parts(개별 부분): 예측 맥락에서 등장하나 요소가 합쳐지는 대상 아님
② large interventions(대규모 개입): 비선형 행동 맥락이지 합쳐지는 장소 아님
③ a complex system(복잡한 체계): 별개 요소들이 복잡한 체계에 합쳐진다 ←정답
④ structural elements(구조적 요소): 요소 자체이지 합쳐지는 대상 아님
